about_the_game:
What is WoColor8?

The software is compatible with FDM 3D printers and can print up to 4,096 colors on a flat surface using 8 different filaments.

Bring your images to life in a brand-new way with Color8, the intuitive tool that transforms ordinary pictures into colorful flat 3D models ready for printing.

With just a few simple steps, you can load any image, instantly preview its transformation into a printable flat design, and fine-tune the result to match your vision. Whether you want to preserve a favorite photo, create decorative wall art, design unique accessories, or turn simple graphics into real objects, WoColor8 provides a seamless path from inspiration to a tangible, colorful print.

No need for complex modeling skills—this software takes care of the heavy lifting. Choose from multiple color palettes or customize your own, scale the model to perfectly match your 3D printer, and preview the details in real time to avoid wasted material and time. When you’re satisfied, a single click generates the final print-ready file.

WoColor8 is designed for hobbyists, makers, designers, educators, and anyone who wants to experiment with creative printing. It’s the fastest and easiest way to bridge the gap between 2D imagination and 3D reality.

Features

  • Convert Images into 3D Flat Models: Instantly turn any picture into a colorful flat 3D print design.

  • Rich Color Options: Choose from predefined palettes or create your own for truly personalized results.

  • Instant Real-Time Preview: See exactly how your model will look before you print—saving both time and filament.

  • Flexible Sizing Tools: Adjust the model’s dimensions to perfectly suit different 3D printers or project needs.

  • One-Click Output: Generate print-ready files with minimal effort, no technical expertise required.

Simple, Smart, and Convenience

In a world where 3D printing often requires complex modeling knowledge, WoColor8 simplifies the process and puts creativity first.
Whether you’re making personalized gifts, unique decorations, classroom projects, or simply experimenting with new ideas, this software helps you transform digital images into colorful real-world objects in minutes.

With WoColor8, your creativity doesn’t just stay on the screen—it becomes something you can hold, display, and share.

You can bring your favorite characters, logos, or in-game art into the real world as colorful flat 3D prints. Turn iconic sprites, cover art, or fan-made designs into tangible collectibles—perfect for decorating your setup, creating unique gifts, or simply celebrating the games you love.
